accepted.s: The New Delhi Declaration adopted at the BRICS Summit in September 2026 was significant because it was:
o: the first BRICS declaration to endorse an SCO development bank
the first BRICS declaration to admit new members
the first BRICS declaration since 2022 with no reference to Ukraine
the first BRICS declaration to establish a common currency
accepted.x: The New Delhi Declaration was unanimously adopted and was the first BRICS declaration since 2022 that contained no reference to Ukraine.
accepted.tq: Use the precise distinguishing feature rather than the broader summit name.
accepted.sec: Summit outcomes - alliances, initiatives, new members, declarations

accepted.s: Which institution has been designated to coordinate the BRICS mental-health centres under the New Delhi Declaration of 2026?
o: National Institute of Mental Health, Brazil
accepted.x: NIMHANS will coordinate the BRICS mental-health centres under the New Delhi Declaration.
accepted.tq: Test the institution associated with a specific initiative.
accepted.sec: Summit outcomes - alliances, initiatives, new members, declarations

accepted.s: The BRICS Photovoltaic Industry Action Plan was adopted at which place in August 2026?
accepted.x: The BRICS Photovoltaic Industry Action Plan was adopted at Jaipur in August 2026 and was welcomed at the 18th BRICS Summit.
accepted.tq: Separate the venue of an initiative from the venue of the main summit.
accepted.sec: Summit outcomes - alliances, initiatives, new members, declarations

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Johannesburg Declaration of the G20 Summit, 2025:
1. It established a Cost of Capital Commission.
2. It revised the Brisbane-eThekwini Goal concerning the gender gap in labour-force participation.
3. It was the first standalone debt declaration since the COVID-19 pandemic.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The declaration addressed borrowing costs, revised the gender-participation target and contained the first standalone debt declaration since COVID-19.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against separate outcome points before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Summit outcomes - alliances, initiatives, new members, declarations

accepted.s: The revised Brisbane-eThekwini Goal aims to reduce the gender gap in labour-force participation by what proportion by 2030, compared with 2012 levels?
accepted.x: The Johannesburg Declaration revised the goal to reduce the gender gap in labour-force participation by 25 percent by 2030 from 2012 levels.
accepted.tq: Focus on the exact target and reference year in a numerical question.
accepted.sec: Summit outcomes - alliances, initiatives, new members, declarations

accepted.s: ACITI, launched on the sidelines of the G20 Johannesburg Summit, 2025, involves which three countries?
accepted.x: ACITI stands for Australia-Canada-India Technology and Innovation and was launched by Australia, Canada and India.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym by identifying the participating countries.
accepted.sec: Summit outcomes - alliances, initiatives, new members, declarations

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?

accepted.s: India explained BRICS at Rio as “Building Resilience and Innovation for Cooperation and Sustainability”. What does this phrase represent?
